scan_mode.description: Mode of operation: 'standard', 'music', or 'picture'. Dictates scanning strategy and engine used.

match_algorithm.description: Filename matching algorithm type. 'fuzzy' for approximate name matching, 'exact' for strict match (only in standard name mode).

match_threshold.description: Matching threshold (0–100) for fuzzy name matching. Higher values require closer matches.

picture_threshold.description: Visual similarity threshold (0–100) for picture mode. Higher values require more visually similar images.

scan_by.description: In standard mode, whether to scan by 'name' or 'content'. Affects scan_type and hash behavior.

file_extensions.description: List of file extensions to include (e.g., ['jpg', 'png', 'mp3', 'pdf']). Empty list means all files.

reference_directories.description: Directories whose files are treated as reference (never marked for deletion).

move_to_trash.description: Whether deleted files go to system trash (true) or are permanently removed (false).
